items.text: REFERRED TO LIBRARIES AND EDUCATION TECHNOLOGY
REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
AMEND (T) AND RECOMMIT TO WAYS AND MEANS

items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to state aid for library projects

A.actClause: AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to the public library construction grant program; and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof

summary: Relates to the public library construction grant program; increases state aid to up to 75% of total costs if the buildings are located in an economically disadvantaged community; provides acquisition of vacant land be considered an approved cost; provides that the application for state aid include documentation demonstrating that the project will address the needs of geographically isolated or economically disadvantaged communities; provides for an annual report on the library projects be submitted to the legislature.
title: Relates to the public library construction grant program
